text.en:
The Nomenclature and the rates of import duty on tariff
headings not enumerated and those listed but represented by the symbol "XXX"
shall remain in force and effect.

Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles
specifically listed in the aforesaid Annex "A" which are entered or withdrawn
from warehouses in the Philippines for consumption shall be levied the rates of
duty herein prescribed.

All other Presidential issuances, administrative rules and
regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are
hereby revoked or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately following
its complete publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general
circulation in the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 15th day of June in the year of Our Lord
Two Thousand and Seven.
Where Me Deridey
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
